title: Early-Household Addition — Mobile In-Home Collection Visits Starting Before 07:30
content:
**Rate card, Specimen Collection Appointments.** A household visit on an early route carries an early-household addition — an amount on the household charge as a whole, reckoned as follows:

| Visit start (appointment start time on the visit record) | Appointment date | Early-household addition |
|---|---|---|
| Before 07:30 | Saturday or Sunday | 10.00 for each additional household member drawn |
| Before 07:30 | Weekday (Monday to Friday) | 6.00 once per visit, whatever the number of members |
| 07:30 or later | Any day | None |

**Clause.** A visit starting before 07:30 on a Saturday or Sunday is charged the early-household addition per member drawn, 10.00 for each additional household member; a visit starting before 07:30 on a weekday is charged it once per visit, 6.00 whatever the number of members; a visit starting at 07:30 or later carries no early-household addition.

The weekend figure is reckoned on the members actually drawn at the visit, each in full.

### Cases (hypothetical visits)

| Day | Start | Members drawn | Addition |
|---|---|---|---|
| Sunday | 07:00 | 3 | 30.00 |
| Saturday | 07:00 | 1 | 10.00 |
| Thursday | 07:00 | 3 | 6.00 |
| Thursday | 07:00 | 1 | 6.00 |
| Saturday | 07:30 | 2 | None — 07:30 is not before 07:30 |
